Does not affect normal basic attacks, companion attacks or purely fixed residual DoTs. Normal attributes, weapons and self buffs retain their existing scaling. Duration 30 minutes, cooldown 60 seconds, cast time 0.3 seconds. Mana cost 54 +16 per additional level, reaching 198.
